'''Osh Scal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massan]] and the medical supply officer of the [[Polis Massa Research Base]]. He was one of few Polis Massans who were able to speak. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], only [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the birth of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]] as well as the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] at the facility, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was disguised as Osh Scal in order to protect the information from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Sancor]].

== Biography ==

=== Early life and birth of the Skywalker twins ===
Toward the end of the Clone Wars, Osh Scal had been the adjunct on an archeological dig.<ref name="LOTJDW">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Dark Warning]]''</ref> In 19 BBY, Osh Scal was present as the dying Padmé Amidala gave birth to Luke and Leia.<ref name="ROTS">''[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>

=== Sancor's investigation ===
A few months after Luke and Leia's birth, an Imperial Inquisitor called Sancor began to conduct investigations at Polis Massa surrounding Amidala's death. He made a thorough and exhaustive search, and requested to meet with Osh Scal. By that point Obi-Wan Kenobi had arrived back on Polis Massa, aware of the twins discovery, and disguised himself as Osh Scal.<ref name="LOTJDW" />
